sentences.en: To answer that question, Mary teamed up with two colleagues.
sentences.zh: 为了回答这个问题，玛丽与两位同事组成了团队。

sentences.en: Paul Connell at Stony Brook University and one of my professor colleagues here.

sentences.zh: 杰斯帕·尼尔森。
